title: Homotopy tensor counit for the explicit inverse-image open square
statement: Let f:X→Y be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], V an open of Y, U=f⁻¹V, and f₀:U→V. Assume the common derived-category instances and additive tensor pullbacks used to name the comparisons. Put F=f_*, rX=restriction to U, b and b₀ the homotopy adjunctions induced by the chosen tensor-pullback adjunctions [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], e_h the sectionwise homotopy direct-image comparison [def-pc-e2-open-homotopy-direct-image-iso], and t_h the constructed homotopy tensor restriction comparison [def-pc-open-pinned-single-tensor-restriction-iso]. For every homotopy object I on X, t_h⁻¹(F_h I) ≫ rX_h(b.counit(I)) = tensorPullback(f₀)_h(e_h(I)) ≫ b₀.counit(rX_h I). Every arrow lies in a homotopy category: no localization, right-derived unit or derived adjunction counit occurs.

proof.text: Use the underived mate identity for the explicit inverse-image open square. Apply Mathlib mateEquiv_counit to obtain the pointwise underived counit equation.

The private proved lemma map_homotopy_counit_square lifts this underived equation: represent I as the homotopy quotient of a complex K, rewrite both mapped adjunction counits using mapHomotopyCategory_counit_app_quotient, express the comparison maps as quotient images of their complex comparisons, and combine quotient map_comp. Equality of complex maps follows by extensionality in degree n from the underived equation at K.X n; identity composition comparisons cancel. Specialize this lemma to tensorPullback f, tensorPullback (f restricted to V), and the two exact restriction functors. The definitions of the two named homotopy comparisons are precisely those in the lemma.

theorem singleComplexOpen_homotopy_tensor_counit
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (k : Y ⟶ Z), (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).Additive]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (V : Y.Opens)
    (I : HomotopyCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (.up ℤ)) :
    let F := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom
    let rX := schemeOpenRestriction X (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    let b := Adjunction.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)
      (Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction f))
    let b₀ := Adjunction.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)
      (Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (f ∣_ V)))
    (openPinnedHomotopyTensorRestrictionIso f V (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (f ∣_ V)
        (morphismRestrict_ι f V)).inv.app ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj I) ≫
      (rX.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).map (b.counit.app I) =
    ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (f ∣_ V)).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).map
        ((singleComplexOpenHomotopyDirectImageIso f V).hom.app I) ≫
      b₀.counit.app ((rX.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj I)
